_doc: c033 BODY-ONLY in Gemini room 2 (still 49041b07; Fendi, 20 Oct: 'Room 2'): the measured scene. Units: metres, pixels at 1080x1920 unless named _full (the still's 1536x2752). Camera frame: X right, depth forward, height up from the floor. Every value is labelled MEASURED (from the files), SPEC, ESTIMATE (assumption, with what it rests on) or DECISION.
_room_scale: DECISION: 1.0; this room's size is set by the camera height and the counter (below)

plate._fps: built at the shot's 59.94 from one still; nothing generative moves
plate._crop: DECISION: the 1536x2752 still is scaled to 1080 wide (1935 rows) and rows 7..1926 kept, so nothing is stretched
plate._focal: MEASURED +/-10 %: the room is one-point (its lines meet one vanishing point), so the focal comes from the Ferrari: its side line (sill, wheel contacts) meets the horizon at x ~-90 full and its front lines at ~4200; orthogonal directions give ~1800 full px (1730-1880). It barely moves him: his size on screen is set by the counter (island.top)
plate._horizon: MEASURED: the room's vanishing point (895.8, 1273.4) full, RANSAC over line segments; verticals within 0.4 deg (median), so pitch 0 and roll 0
plate._principal: MEASURED: the vanishing point's column; the room's depth axis is the camera's, so the optical axis sits right of centre (lens shift, yaw 0)
plate._height: ESTIMATE: the Purosangue's roof (SPEC 1.589 m) sits 5 px above the horizon at ~9.5 m (1.56 m); both counters read top/camera 0.598 (MEASURED: the island's far-end top 1525 and floor 1900 full; the left counter's top and toe line at one column), a 0.927 m counter. 1.52-1.58 m fits all three

room_v5._doc: The layered-still lane: room_layers_still.py splits the still, snow.py renders the snow, room_motion.py sways the branches inside the glass and runs the LED band on the car's lamps. Pixels on the still are _full (1536x2752); boxes named _1080 are on the plate.
room_v5._lamps: MEASURED on the still: the two lit DRL strips (left, right), each with ~8 px for its glow
room_v5._flakes: DECISION: the still's painted snowflakes over dark sky are removed so the only snow that moves is Blender's
room_v5._glass: MEASURED on a pixel grid of the still (full px): the window wall's panes, its two mullions and transom; the car (masks/room2_car_matte.png, traced on a 1:1 grid and snapped by GrabCut) is cut out

wind._: DECISION: one wind for the whole yard, strength 0.38-1.12 of its mean over the shot (a slow gust every ~3 s and a quicker flutter); the snow and the branches both follow it

snow._probe: MEASURED with --probe (5000 flakes): fall 1.11 m/s and drift 1.11 m/s (medians); the wind field is a flow (drag toward the wind), so gravity 0.047 balances it at the fall speed
snow._: the v9 snow (same physics, seed and density: 45000 flakes over 32 m x 18 m), from just beyond the glass (13.5 m, MEASURED from the window's floor line) to 32 m, across the window

trees._: as v9: up to 1.4 px with the gusts, none at the snowy lawn's far edge (y 928, MEASURED), full at the top of the glass

led._: ESTIMATE/DECISION: a phone reads its sensor rows over ~13 ms per frame (~6.8 us a row at 1920 rows); LED lamps driven at ~1.62 kHz PWM span ~90 rows per on/off cycle, so a lamp 40-60 rows tall carries about half a dark band. 1.62 kHz is 27.03 cycles per 59.94 fps frame, so the bands crawl 0.03 cycle (2.7 rows) a frame. Depth 0.55 is the share of light the band takes out at its darkest (an exposure longer than the PWM period softens it)

island._: the island runs toward the camera; its far end's top edge (y 1525 full) and its left corner (x 980 full) MEASURED and lifted with the camera above; its right corner is out of frame (width ESTIMATE 1.45 m, at least 1.38 seen); it runs past the bottom of the frame (length ESTIMATE)

_proxies: the surfaces the plate is projected onto, so the dolly gets parallax. MEASURED with the camera above: the kitchen's base and counter front at X -1.167 (its toe line and counter edge through the vanishing point), the run ending at 5.39 m, the window's floor line at 13.5 m, the ceiling 4.95 m at the window; the car's near wheels at (-1.31, 10.52) and (-0.08, 8.08), heading 26.6 deg (its side vanishing point), roof 1.58 m. ESTIMATE: counter depth 0.6 m, the upper cabinets' face, the column, the car's overhangs and width (Purosangue SPEC, scaled 0.9 like its drawn wheelbase)

source.camera: SPEC iPhone 14, 4K 59.94, main lens; locked-off (MEASURED, under 0.3 px drift)
source._roll: MEASURED: four door/frame verticals lean -0.96..-1.56 deg the same way; corrected by rotating the take +1.23 deg (geometry only)
source._ppm: ESTIMATE, anchored on Fendi's stated height 6 ft 3 in (1.905 m, 19 Oct): outer eye corners 110.6 px (MEASURED median of 28 frames) over 0.095 m, and eyes-to-waistband 809 px (MEASURED) over ~0.70 m, agree within 1 %. First pass used 1229 (a 0.090 m assumption, 1.80 m man): he read short
source._shorizon: MEASURED level phone (verticals parallel), no lens shift
source._eye: From Fendi's stated height 1.905 m (eyes ~0.125 m below the top of the head); sets how far his head rises above the counter
source._below: the take's camera sat (horizon_y - eye_y) / px_per_metre = 0.245 m below his eyes (MEASURED ratio)

performer._: DECISION (Fendi chose room 2, 20 Oct): he stands just beyond the island's far end, 0.25 m off it (body centre; his front ~0.1 m off the stone), 0.59 m in from its left corner, so the counter's top edge crosses his whole width at the upper thigh (the take is framed thighs-up; its bottom is 0.71 m on his plane, the stone's edge 0.90 m) and the Ferrari stands behind him, its DRLs at his waist

light._wp: MEASURED: the white wall beside the window (x 366-384, y 600-1200 on the plate), median; a white vertical surface in the room's own light, as the penguin belly was in v9
light._ws: MEASURED: the white door beside him in the take
light._exposure: DECISION (checked on his face at +0 / +0.3 / +0.6, frame 1): at +0 his face is dim against the lit window; +0.3 reads eyes, glasses and mouth and keeps the jacket just under the lit marble's brightness
light._top: DECISION: this room's downlights are behind him (5-11 m, MEASURED on the ceiling), so a softer gradient than v9's: +0.1 stop at the head, -0.25 at the counter
light._flash: kept from v9; the plate is one still, so the reference ratio is 1 on every frame (MEASURED by measure_plate_light.py on the island-top box) and nothing flickers on him

tight._: DECISION: the matched camera with a 2.0x lens, framed on him (an exact crop of the wide, so placement and perspective are unchanged). In this room he stands ~4.7 m from the camera, 0.76x the size he had in the v9 room, so 2.0x (not 1.6x) gives his face about the v9 tight size; the frame stops at the plate's right edge

lens._wrap: DECISION (Fendi, 20 Oct: 'there is bleed I believe from the headlight effect, it looks like I'm coming out of the environment'): the composite lane's 0.5 screen wrap of the blurred room left a pale rim on his outline against the snowy window and carried the Ferrari lamps' rolling band onto his car-side edge; 0.15 keeps the edge in the room's light without the halo (checked at 0.5 / 0.15 / 0 on frames 60, 120, 180)
lens._soft: DECISION: his 4K-derived pixels are crisper than the 1080 AI plate; a 0.5 px lens softness puts him in the same camera (optics, not a redraw)
lens._: DECISION: depth of field from the scene depth, focused on him; 1-4 px of blur on the island and the room

reflection._: DECISION: polished stone at a ~12 deg grazing view

_dolly: DECISION: the dolly pushes 0.12 m straight in (v9: 0.20 m). This island starts ~0.9 m from the lens, so 0.20 m read as a zoom (checked on frame 240); 0.12 m keeps the move gentle and the proxies' depth errors small

performer_prep._: DECISION: the take's texture at 0.25 (static, dolly) and 0.5 (tight) of 1080, so Blender minifies it by no more than ~10 %. No matte change: on Fendi's note (21 Oct, 'pixelation blur and flashing around my edges') three matte fixes were tried and rejected, see the write-up (Room 2, 'Edge flashing')
